events.name: Bent String
events.info: Bent String performs a mix of early American roots music, including early jazz and acoustic blues, along with original songs written by members of the band. The quintet centers on the vocals of Kari Ann Rutushin and underpinned with the feel of jazz-age swing with Reed Simon's hot violin, Caroline King's sublime accordion, Kevin Richards' arch-top guitars, and Cleveland Blues Hall of Fame upright bassist, Raymond DeForest.

events.name: Chloe Kimes w/ Lea Marra & The River Boys
Rita Bliss
events.info: Rita Bliss is an old-school folk musician, originally from Rochester, New York. Now based in Austin, Texas, she has become known for her unique story-telling style: songs performed on the banjo that capture snapshots of Texas life, long drives, and intimate proclamations of love. Her debut album, Peaches and Apple Pies, was described by Americana Highways as Just great American music.
